title: MOTO GP 26
description:

- Novo Modelo 3D da MotoGP26
- 22 Pilotos
- 24 Circuitos (12 Novos Circuitos)
- Circuito de Mandalika Real
- Textura HD
- Desempenho Realista dos Pilotos
- Biografias Reais dos Pilotos e Equipes
- Novo Nível de Dificuldade
- Novo Layout do Menu

description_en:
The incredible MotoGP 26 Mod for PSP is a fan-made modification (typically based on classic racing games like MotoGP or SBK 09) designed to run on the IGAMES PSP app! The game features updated liveries, teams, and riders from the 2026 season.

Game Features:

- New MotoGP 26 3D models
- 22 riders
- 24 circuits (including 12 new ones)
- Authentic Mandalika Circuit
- HD textures
- Realistic rider performance
- Accurate biographies for riders and teams
- New difficulty level
- New menu layout
- New music
